entities.summary: Alaa Salah gained media attention due to a photo of her standing on top of a car during the 2018-2019 revolution in Sudan, which was later coined the "women's revolution." She is also a member of a Sudanese women's network called MANSAM, which signed the Freedom and Change Declaration calling for the removal of Omar al-Bashir in January 2019.
